title: Selenium and Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Selenium for Hair Loss: Levels, Studies & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: Selenium levels were lower in alopecia areata but higher in telogen effluvium in two studies. See what research says and why too much is a risk.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
